sources.snippet: A 568M XLM-RoBERTa model for detecting personal and clinical identifiers in Spanish clinical and biomedical text. Runs locally after download on Python CPU, in the browser, and on Android.

sources.title: OpenMed-PII-Spanish-ClinicalBGE-568M-v1 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description OpenMed-PII-Spanish-ClinicalBGE-568M-v1 is a transformer-based token classification model fine-tuned for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection in Spanish text. This model identifies and classifies 54 types of sensitive information including names, addresses, social security numbers, medical record numbers, and more.

sources.title: OpenMed / OpenMed-PII-Spanish-ClinicalBGE-Large-568M-v1
sources.snippet: OpenMed-PII-Spanish-ClinicalBGE-Large-568M-v1 is a Spanish clinical NLP model that labels personal and sensitive information in medical text, such as patient names, dates, and record numbers, so that it can be masked or removed before data sharing. It is built on a BGE-Large encoder with a token classification head and is distributed through the Huawei/Ascend Modelers.cn platform. Developers ...

sources.title: OpenMed / OpenMed-PII-Spanish-ClinicalBGE-Large-335M-v1
sources.snippet: This is a Spanish-language clinical PII detection model built on the ClinicalBGE-Large encoder. It is intended to identify personally identifiable information in medical and clinical documents so that the text can be safely de-identified.
